summary: Backend-only iteration 12: order SMS notification flow + regression. 16/16 pytest cases pass. Live Twilio actually delivered SMS to BOTH the customer (+355695808480) and the store owner (+355695808480) on happy-path order placement — both notification_customer and notification_owner returned channel='sms' with valid Twilio SIDs (e.g. SMeba5b80abf65af6bbf8bff79263a9841). On simulated outage (customer phone corrupted to 'bad-phone' via DB), the order still returned 200, notification_customer={sent:false, channel:'invalid'} and owner still succeeded. Helper builders build_customer_order_sms / build_owner_order_sms produce the required content (Bharat Bazaar / MBC id / COD / L total / ETA min / NEW ORDER / customer name+phone / address). Config exposes STORE_OWNER_PHONE='+355695808480' and STORE_NAME='Bharat Bazaar'. Regression endpoints (health, categories, products?category=snacks, offers/banners, admin/auth/login, auth/login, forgot-password/send-otp with real +355695808480 → DB record purpose='reset' created, register/send-otp unknown phone → DB record without purpose, cart POST/GET, offers/validate-coupon WELCOME10@2000) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/notifications.py send_sms is well-contained: never raises, returns typed dict with channel enum. Good.
routes/orders.py wraps notify_order_placed in try/except so any unexpected exception cannot break the order response — correct implementation of 'SMS failures must NOT block the order'.
Order is inserted before SMS attempt, then updated with notification fields — persistence-first pattern is correct.
auth.py _send_sms_otp now correctly delegates to services.notifications.send_sms; response shape preserved (debug_code returned when SMS not sent).
config.py loads STORE_OWNER_PHONE and STORE_NAME from env with correct defaults; .env has both keys.
Minor: services/notifications.py logs at WARNING when Twilio not configured — appropriate.
seed_data_creation: Two real orders were placed against the quick-user account (+355695808480) during testing; per instructions no cleanup performed. Real Twilio SMS were actually delivered to +355695808480 on the happy path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct frontend env var (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). /api/offers/banners returns {banners:[...], count:n}, not a bare list. Quick-user id is 'quick-user-001'. To simulate a Twilio outage for the customer side, update db.users.phone to a non-E.164 string; owner side remains valid because STORE_OWNER_PHONE is set. Notification channels observed in this run: 'sms' (real Twilio SID) and 'invalid'.
rca_of_issue: No bug found. Implementation matches the spec: (a) SMS is attempted after order persistence with try/except guard; (b) notification_sent_at + notification_customer + notification_owner are set on the order doc post-attempt; (c) Twilio failure modes ('invalid' | 'twilio_error' | 'mock' | 'misconfigured' | 'no_phone' | 'no_owner_phone' | 'error') never propagate to the /orders response; (d) helpers produce bodies containing Bharat Bazaar / order id / COD / L total / ETA min (customer) and NEW ORDER / id / name / phone / address (owner).
